integrity: The self-contained proof is the basis of the theorem; finite exhaustive and sampled verification is corroborative and does not certify the infinite claim.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple graphs and binary vertex subsets only. The observed two-sorted edge-incidence channel is not the classical same-universe equivalence-based approximation. The spectrum recovers only the specified component statistics, not graph isomorphism; rank-three hyperedges need not yield power-of-two fibers. Publication priority is not independently established.
title: Edge-granulation ambiguity spectra classify bipartite component orders
